name: Aki Kyouko
source:
Hobbies: Baking, flower arrangement.
Likes: Cute girls, tea.
Dislikes: Pickles.
Her obsession: Fondling girl's upper arms. 

A warm and snug beautiful girl. Kyouko does things at her own pace and definitely is an airhead. Every time she spots a cute girl, she can't help but pat her or link arms with her. She doesn't realize that by doing this she stands out and behaves a bit like a lesbian. Kyouko's body structure suits her character, her figure looks cute, lovely and soft. The part that stands out the most are her breasts, a detail that cannot go unnoticed by our protagonist, [url=/c12036]Akira[/url].
Kyouko often makes handmade candy and brings it to school to share with everybody.
Despite her being so warm and fluffy all the time, she sometimes can be severe and say deceitful words.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=769298]Getchu[/url].]
